verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਕਰ ਅਮਲੀ ਸੋਫੀਆਂ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਦੀ ਚਉਕੀ ਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: chaakar amalee sofeeaa(n) paatisaeh dhee chaukee aae|

en.bdb: Servants, addict (of the Lord's name) as well as teetotallers devoid of Mitn came to the Lord king's presence.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਾਜਰ ਹਾਜਰਾਂ ਲਿਖੀਅਨਿ ਗੈਰ ਹਾਜਰਾਂ ਗੈਰ ਹਾਜਰ ਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: haajar haajaraa(n) likheean gair haajaraa(n) gair haajar laae|

en.bdb: Those present are marked present and those absent are declared absent.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਾਇਕ ਦੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਮਜਲਸ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਦਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: laik dhe veechaar kai virale majalas vich sadhaae|

en.bdb: The intelligent king (God) selected a few to be his courtiers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਹੁਸਿਆਰ ਮਸਤ ਖੁਸ ਫਹਿਮੀ ਦੋਵੇ ਪਰਚਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: paatisaahu husiaar masat khus fahimee dhove parachaae|

en.bdb: He, a clever person, made both the clever and the indifferent happy and put them to work.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਨਿ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਅਮਲੀਆਂ ਸੋਫੀ ਸਭ ਪਿਆਵਣ ਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: dhen piaale amaleeaa(n) sofee sabh piaavan laae|

en.bdb: Now, the so called teetotallers (religious persons) were engaged to serve drinks (nam) to the addicts.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ਅਮਲੀ ਹੁਏ ਪੀ ਪੀ ਚੜ੍ਹੇ ਸਹਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: matavaale amalee hue pee pee chaRhe sahij ghar jaae|

en.bdb: The latter became exhilerated in the name of the Lord and attained tranquility

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਫੀ ਮਾਰਨਿ ਟਕਰਾਂ ਪੂਜ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਸੀਸ ਨਿਵਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: soofee maaran Takaraa(n) pooj nivaaje sees nivaae|

en.bdb: But the so-called religious persons (teetotallers who served mans to others) remained involved in the so-called prayer and ritualistic worship.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਅਜਾਬ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਖੁਦੀ ਬਹਸ ਬਹਸਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: vedh kateb ajaab vich kar kar khudhee bahas bahasaae|

en.bdb: They under the tyranny of their religious books, the Vedas and the Katebas, kept busy in arrogant debates and discussions.
Ny rare gurmukh attains the fruit of the delight (of quaffing the drink of Lord's name).
